title: ExplainableFold: Understanding AlphaFold Prediction with Explainable AI

problem.claim: The reasons behind AI-based protein structure predictions remain unclear.

gap.claim: The black-box nature of deep learning models limits understanding of AlphaFold's predictions.

contributions.claim: ExplainableFold (xFold), an explainable AI framework for protein structure prediction.
A biologically inspired counterfactual learning framework that generates counterfactual explanations for protein structure prediction and supports dry-lab experimentation.
Source code and data for ExplainableFold are available.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that ExplainableFold generates high-quality explanations for AlphaFold predictions.
The authors report that the explanations provide near-experimental understanding of how amino acids affect 3D protein structure.
The authors state that the framework has the potential to deepen understanding of protein structures.

narrative_sequence.summary: Introduces ExplainableFold as an explainable AI framework for protein structure prediction.
Identifies the lack of clarity about AlphaFold's prediction reasons due to deep-learning opacity.
Proposes a biologically inspired counterfactual learning approach for generating explanations and enabling dry-lab experimentation.
Reports high-quality explanations and near-experimental understanding of amino-acid effects on 3D protein structure.
States potential for deeper understanding of protein structures and provides project code and data.

source_observation.claim: Counterfactual explanations are used to examine how amino acids affect predicted 3D protein structures.

interpretation.claim: Biologically grounded counterfactual analysis may make opaque structure-prediction behavior more interpretable.

application.claim: Apply counterfactual perturbations to investigate feature-level effects in other opaque scientific prediction models.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether the approach generalizes beyond protein structure prediction or AlphaFold.

unknowns: Experimental datasets, baselines, metrics, and procedures are not specified.
The meaning of high-quality and near-experimental understanding is not operationalized.
Limitations, computational requirements, and independent validation are not described.
